notice: SYNTHETIC ROLE-BASED SIMULATION — NOT BASED ON THESE EMPLOYEES' ACTUAL BEHAVIOR OR WORK HISTORY.
summary: A fictional data-engineering project ingesting product telemetry into bronze, silver, and curated layers with quality, lineage, and replay controls.

decisions.evidence_text:
SYNTHETIC ROLE-BASED SIMULATION — NOT BASED ON THESE EMPLOYEES' ACTUAL BEHAVIOR OR WORK HISTORY.
Hrishikesh Mohile: Define trust gates for curated telemetry. Choice: Block publication when freshness, completeness, or reconciliation misses its SLO. Rationale: Consumers need trustworthy data rather than green jobs. Outcome: Synthetic bad-data publication dropped from 11 cases to 0.
decisions.page_or_segment: section at 2026-09-15 09:00 — Hrishikesh Mohile (Principal Software Engineering Manager)
decisions.decision: Define trust gates for curated telemetry
decisions.choice: Block publication when freshness, completeness, or reconciliation misses its SLO
alternatives: Publish whenever the pipeline reports success
rationale: Consumers need trustworthy data rather than green jobs
risks: Strict gates can delay partially useful data
decisions.outcome: Synthetic bad-data publication dropped from 11 cases to 0.

Amrita Shanbhag: Separate ingestion validation from transformation. Choice: Validate the envelope before writing bronze and record reason codes. Rationale: One boundary produces consistent failures and simpler transforms. Outcome: Invalid synthetic records were classified with 100% reason coverage.

rationale: One boundary produces consistent failures and simpler transforms

decisions.outcome: Invalid synthetic records were classified with 100% reason coverage.
